statement: Where EPA's Worker Protection Standard applies, worker employers must keep workers and other persons out of areas being treated with pesticides except for appropriately trained and equipped handlers, and nurseries and greenhouses can require an additional entry-restricted area during some applications.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed EPA page on restrictions during pesticide applications under WPS and cross-checked against the current EPA page on September 15, 2026. The statement distinguishes during-application restrictions from post-application restricted-entry intervals and is conditional on WPS applicability.
review.notes: Human regulatory/safety review is required before promotion. Do not generalize the nursery/greenhouse entry-restricted-area rule beyond the application conditions covered by WPS.
